skill.name: pre-commit-check
skill.description: Runs a lightweight pre-commit quality check for changed backend and frontend files.
skill.summary: Checks lint, targeted tests, compile status, and TypeScript types before commit.
skill.author: Crearize

security_audit.summary: Confirmed command-execution risk is limited to documented Gradle, pnpm, and npx checks that run project-controlled tooling. The remaining static detections are Markdown fences, inline file paths, report examples, or a high-entropy heuristic on readable Japanese Markdown; no prompt injection or obfuscation evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Project-local Gradle and pnpm commands can execute repository-controlled code.
remediation.suggestion: Require user confirmation before running these scripts and show the exact commands first.

remediation.issue: The npx type-check command may execute package binaries or fetch tooling.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a pinned local TypeScript command or require confirmation before any package execution.

remediation.issue: The skill does not state trust boundaries for running build tools.
remediation.suggestion: Add guidance to use the skill only in trusted repositories or after reviewing project scripts.

content.value_statement: Late quality failures slow commits and reviews. This skill guides Claude, Codex, or Claude Code through fast lint, test, compile, and type checks before committing.
actual_capabilities: Lists changed and staged files with Git status commands.
Runs Gradle Checkstyle and SpotBugs checks for backend changes.
Runs targeted Gradle tests when test execution is enabled.
Runs pnpm lint and changed-file tests for frontend changes.
Runs TypeScript type checking without emitting files.
Formats success and failure summaries with next steps.
limitations: Does not run the full qa-check workflow.
May skip build steps when speed is prioritized.
Requires configured Gradle, pnpm, Biome, and TypeScript tooling.

use_cases.title: Commit Readiness Check
use_cases.description: Run a focused quality pass before committing local changes.

use_cases.title: Frontend Change Validation
use_cases.description: Check lint, changed tests, and TypeScript status after UI edits.

use_cases.title: Backend Quality Sweep
use_cases.description: Run style, static analysis, related tests, and compile checks for backend updates.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Pre-Commit Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the pre-commit check for my current changes. Keep tests enabled and summarize only blocking issues.

prompt_templates.title: Frontend-Only Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Check only frontend changes. Run lint, changed tests, and type checks, then list fixes by priority.

prompt_templates.title: Backend Staged Check
prompt_templates.prompt: Run backend checks for staged changes. Include Checkstyle, SpotBugs, related tests, and compile results.

prompt_templates.title: Selective Risk-Aware Check
prompt_templates.scenario: When the change set is mixed
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare staged and unstaged changes, choose the smallest safe check set, ask before running project scripts, and report remaining risks.

output_examples.input: Run a normal pre-commit check before I commit.
output: Backend lint and compile checks passed.
Frontend type checking found one blocking issue.
Commit should wait until the type issue is fixed.

output_examples.input: Skip tests and check only frontend files.
output_examples.output: The report notes that tests were skipped, frontend lint passed, type checking passed, and follow-up testing is still required.

best_practices: Review the exact commands before approving project script execution.
Keep tests enabled unless the commit is urgent and low risk.
Run the full qa-check workflow before opening a pull request.
anti_patterns: Using this skill as the only release gate.
Skipping tests after changing behavior or shared code.
Running project scripts from repositories you do not trust.

faq.question: What does this skill check?
faq.answer: It checks changed files with Git, backend quality tasks, frontend lint, selected tests, and TypeScript types.

faq.question: Is this a replacement for qa-check?
faq.answer: No. It is a faster local check for commits. The full qa-check workflow is still needed before pull requests.

faq.question: Can tests be skipped?
faq.answer: Yes, but the skill recommends skipping tests only for urgent, low-risk changes.

faq.question: Does it run coverage checks?
faq.answer: No. The source skill states that coverage is not checked in this lightweight workflow.

faq.question: Which project tools does it expect?
faq.answer: It expects Git, Bash, Gradle, pnpm, Biome linting, and TypeScript type checking to be available.

faq.question: Should I approve every command automatically?
faq.answer: No. Review commands first, especially Gradle, pnpm, and npx commands in unfamiliar repositories.
